This document describes how eight electronic products were separated from three sectors of the BONSAI 2016 hybrid multi-regional supply-use tables (MRSUT), so that each product has its own production activity, commodity and market in every region. The resulting tables are used for the environmental and socio-economic assessment of circular strategies in the main article.
